dataset: Stanford Dynamic Cycling – Cell 034 measured C/40 pOCV
cell: commercial EV-energy cylindrical cell; manufacturer and model not disclosed
measurement: periodic 2.8–4.2 V C/40 diagnostic; pOCV is the pointwise average of measured C/40 charge and discharge voltage
sohBasis: C/40 discharge capacity divided by the first Cell 034 C/40 discharge capacity
